reason: Mara Kettle the net-mender left to find a better place to work, leaving only one Mara Kettle in town.

citizen.name: Sable Flux
citizen.innate: curious about everything, prone to wandering off
citizen.learned: Sable grew up in a coastal village where they learned to read the tides and predict the weather.
citizen.lifestyle: Sable spends most of their time near the water, observing the ebb and flow of the tides.
citizen.currently: Sable is curious about the recent changes in the tidal patterns and is determined to understand their cause.

relationships: Sable and Caspian often discuss their tide readings and theories.

citizen.name: Lena Loom
citizen.learned: Lena learned weaving from her grandmother and has been perfecting her craft ever since.
citizen.lifestyle: Lena spends most of her time in her weaving studio, creating beautiful textiles.
citizen.currently: Lena is searching for a suitable space to open a weaving studio and shop.

relationships: Lena and Tobiah are neighbors and often chat about their respective crafts.
Lena and Emmet have become close friends since she arrived in Vesper.
Lena and Petra have had a few conversations about the town's history.
Lena and Rune have discussed the possibility of collaborating on a project.
Lena and Mira have chatted a few times at the Salt Kettle.
